svg.title: GitOps agent control plane - solution architecture
svg.desc: An Azure Kubernetes Service control plane with an API, event worker, optional GitLab poller and MCP, PostgreSQL, and external GitLab, Argo CD and Harbor integrations. The gateway, webhook route, CI integration and deployment of new features require separate configuration.
svg.text: Solution architecture - current implementation and separately configured integrations
Azure Kubernetes Service - agent control plane
Helm deployments - no direct Kubernetes API permissions
Inbox, audit ledger, checkpoints, traceability, bundles and rollback plans
Staging uses an in-cluster, test-only PostgreSQL instance
Filtered query keywords to model; validated intent returned
Worker and poller; API configured separately
Raw questions stay in the application
Safety: no automatic promotion or merge. A draft rollback MR requires separate approval, enabled writes and GitLab review.
The staging image predates query, bundle and rollback. LangGraph currently checkpoints outcomes; it does not orchestrate these agents.
